name: Life spaceship 3b16f6b5 on 3-uniform tiling k3-002
description: A period-3 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-002, with touching neighbours, 14 to 16 cells, moving one lattice step every 3 generations (c/3). It runs the same way in the 1,024 rules from B3/S23 to B3789/S23789. JETCARP's Life census met it in 10 of its 50,000 soups on this tiling. It contains a perturbed phase of the smaller ship d45da3415a5ce6c5.
